title: Estimating QPS and peak QPS

kcs.statement: Average QPS = daily active users × actions per user per day ÷ ~10^5 seconds.
Peak QPS is estimated as a multiple of average QPS (commonly 2–3×, higher for spiky events), and capacity is sized for peak, not average.
Read QPS and write QPS are estimated separately by applying the read-to-write ratio, because they scale with different components.
